title: Open neighbourhoods of a point
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and $x\in X$. An *open neighbourhood* of $x$ in $X$ is an open subset $U\subseteq X$ with $x\in U$. The open neighbourhoods of $x$ form a nonempty set (it contains $X$ itself).
